Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, November 1 · NFL Week 8 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 1, 2:24 PM ET

Jayden Daniels has the highest SPAGS projection in the Eagles at Commanders DraftKings Showdown: 20.0 points at $10,400 FLEX, 30.0 at captain for $15,600. In a game totaled at 40.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.6 times, and across 10,000 simulations he holds 84% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Daniels is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.3 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 35.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Daniels at captain. Saquon Barkley is the next captain in line, at 14.0%. The model gives him 17.0 carries and 2.1 targets.

Washington is a 6-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.25 for the Commanders and 17.25 for the Eagles. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Daniels and Barkley, the next projections are Tanner McKee (12.3, $8,800), Rachaad White (11.9, $8,000) and Dallas Goedert (11.7, $7,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 1, 2:24 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 35.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 20.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 20.0 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 40.3. He holds 84% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 35.1% as the captain and 49.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Saquon Barkley, PHI RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Saquon Barkley holds 14.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 13.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 19.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 17.0 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Barkley averaged 13.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.9 and a ceiling of 31.8. He holds 48% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.0% as the captain and 34.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Dallas Goedert, PHI TE ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Dallas Goedert holds 9.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $11,100 and the 11.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 17.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.8 targets on 20.9 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Goedert averaged 11.7 points with a simulated floor of 3.1 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.7% as the captain and 36.1% in a FLEX spot.

Tanner McKee, PHI QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations Lemon averaged 10.2 points with a simulated floor of 3.3 and a ceiling of 22.2. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.2% as the captain and 34.1% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Drew Stevens, WAS K ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

Drew Stevens projects for 8.3 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.81 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Stevens averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.9% as the captain and 28.9% in a FLEX spot.

Commanders projects for 6.7 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.68 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Commanders averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of -0.6 and a ceiling of 16.1. It holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.4% as the captain and 24.3% in a FLEX spot.

Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 35.1%, ahead of Saquon Barkley (14.0%) and Dallas Goedert (9.7%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Eagles vs Commanders?

Build around Dallas Goedert at captain with Jayden Daniels, Tanner McKee and Rachaad White at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (17 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $11,700 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels leads the SPAGS model at 20.0 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 30.0 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Eagles vs Commanders Showdown?

Jayden Daniels is the most expensive player at $10,400 FLEX and $15,600 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Drew Stevens (8.3 points at $4,600), Commanders (6.7 points at $4,000) and Jake Elliott (7.3 points at $5,000).

What is the Eagles vs Commanders spread and total?

The Commanders are a 6-point favorite in a game totaled at 40.5, with implied team totals of 23.25 for the Commanders and 17.25 for the Eagles.
